build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
reference: Generate the two source rows using original GGML F16/BF16 conversion of ((37*i+11) mod 291 - 145)/37 and the F32 addend ((13*i+7) mod 29 - 14)/32. Evaluate ggml_add_cast to F32 on the pinned CPU. Encode each row with the CPU from_float callback where defined, otherwise use ggml_quantize_chunk with its declared importance rule.
